## System Overview
The `trampette-schemes` Swift package provides a library that models, loads, and searches Apple and third-party app URL schemes for Apple platforms.

## Subdirectories & System Boundaries
- [Sources](./Sources/README.md) — Swift package source tree containing the `TrampetteSchemes` module.

## Global Invariants
- Every scheme entry carries both a human-readable `Label` and a URL `Scheme` string.

## Global Side Effects
- Shared package resources: the `Apple.plist` and `ThirdParty.plist` bundle resources are loaded from the library bundle during `AppSchemes` initialization.

## System Verification
- Run: `swift build`
